resetTitle: Reset the hub to its first start?
resetBody: Settings, points, tariff, Wi-Fi, tokens and the access-point password are erased. The hub then starts its own access point {ssid}; connect to it to set it up again. This app loses the hub.
resetSent: The hub is restarting as new. Connect to its access point {ssid} to set it up.
